title: micp-ureolysis-chemistry input envelope
description: Envelope passed by the Obsidian controller when invoking the skill. Follows the Obsidian Plan project convention (see obsidian-mission-lock schemas). Version 1.0.0.

task_id.description: Unique task identifier (UUID/ULID), generated by the controller

context.description: Free-form context. Reserved keys: pathway, matrix, draft_calc, simulation (a full simulate params object), species (a species snapshot), evidence

pathway.description: MICP pathway. This skill models UREOLYSIS only; non-urea pathways must not reuse this model (returns BLOCKED / NEED_ADDITIONAL_SKILL otherwise)

matrix.description: Porous-medium type: sand / clay / rock fracture / concrete / batch

draft_calc.description: A draft calculation result object for programmatic re-checking

simulation.description: Full simulate_batch params for direct tool dispatch

species.description: Species -> mol/L snapshot for conservation checks

evidence_refs.description: URIs/paths/DOIs of evidence the calculation may cite

data_refs.description: URIs/paths of input data (e.g. time-series CSV for fitting)

skill_version.description: Skill version the caller expects; cross-major mismatch without migration is rejected (MUC-E1010)

tool.description: Direct machine dispatch: run the named CLI tool with params. When omitted, the LLM layer interprets request and dispatches.

params.description: Params passed to the dispatched tool (only valid with tool set)
